description: This file defines an interface for AWS SDK clients in PHP, specifying method signatures for executing commands, retrieving configurations, iterators, paginators, and waiters related to AWS services.

classes.name: AwsClientInterface
classes.description: An interface representing an AWS service client, outlining methods for command execution, configuration retrieval, pagination, and waiting mechanisms.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, enabling asynchronous operation suffixes with 'Async' and command execution.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Creates a command object for a specified AWS operation with given arguments.

methods.name: executeAsync
methods.description: Executes a given command asynchronously, returning a promise.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Returns a promise for the AWS credentials object.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Retrieves the AWS region configured for the client.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the client's default endpoint URI.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Returns the service description associated with the client.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration options for the client.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Returns the handler list used for transferring commands.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator for a specified operation.

methods.name: getPaginator
methods.description: Provides a paginator for a specified operation.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: Waits synchronously until a resource reaches a certain state.

methods.name: getWaiter
methods.description: Returns a waiter object to wait asynchronously for a resource to reach a state.
